remaining_tasks.name: Resolve reported Free Imitation release behavior
remaining_tasks.details: The user still perceives missing NoteOff in Free Imitation. Existing CanonLane Cancel-mode and per-voice duration tests pass. Reproduce with the effective global > lane > voice Hold stack and transport state visible. Near/Future, Phrase, and Forever intentionally schedule completion after source release; Cancel should release emitted notes at the current beat. Check for a persisted per-voice override winning over group/global Hold and for a stopped transport preventing future-beat cleanup. Do not call it fixed until an observed Free Imitation NoteOn/NoteOff sequence is captured.

remaining_tasks.name: Define global arrangement presets
remaining_tasks.details: Design user-facing full-arrangement presets inspired by old/new classical, jazz, and video-game composers. First define exactly which existing backend fields an arrangement preset owns: harmony/key/scale defaults, Your register, voice count/spread, Canon form/voices/delays/ratios/holds, Species Counterpoint, per-role synth levels/mute/solo, and routing policy. Built-ins remain immutable; customization is Save As. Avoid exposing controls or extra groups that backend support does not exist for.

decisions.decision: The native prototype is one fixed-ratio performance page with one centered Setup dialog.
decisions.rationale: The user rejected tabs and scrolling. Live expression, notes, arrangement, routing state, and critical controls must stay visible together.
This locks the requested ratio and lets the main page fit without scrolling.

decisions.decision: Chrome remains black and white; color is reserved for guitar pitch, emitted MIDI, harmony, Canon, Counterpoint, active piano keys, and meters.
decisions.rationale: Color should communicate sound and role rather than decorate controls.

decisions.decision: Mixer levels are real built-in-synth role gains, not mocked controls.
decisions.rationale: Per-role atomics and mix-group-aware Synth events provide immediate native audio behavior without adding fake external-MIDI gain semantics.
Soprano/Alto/Tenor/Bass place the performed line in the arrangement without transposing the physical input note.

decisions.decision: Strict Canon locks per-voice Mode but permits Canon group Hold.
decisions.rationale: Per-voice harmony modes break strict imitation, while group release policy does not. Free Imitation unlocks per-voice Mode, Relative, Speed, Preset, and Hold.

decisions.decision: Hidden Setup controls must not consume Guitar CC74 as MIDI-learn input.
decisions.rationale: The hidden PerformanceView treated guitar brightness CC74 as a mapped hardware knob, causing native-only reharmonization on every pluck. Gating and unmounting the listener restored exact 4:1 synth dispatch per four-voice guitar event.

decisions.decision: Built-in global arrangement presets remain immutable and user changes use Save As.
decisions.rationale: This preserves reproducible named arrangements while allowing customization.

validation.details: Before the CC74 listener fix: 29 guitar NoteOns caused 374 synth NoteOns. After: 32 guitar NoteOns caused exactly 128 synth NoteOns and 31 guitar NoteOffs caused exactly 124 synth NoteOffs; the final four-event difference was one currently held note. Zero CC123 overflows.

next_action: First reproduce the Free Imitation release complaint with effective global/lane/voice Hold modes and transport state recorded. If Cancel produces immediate emitted NoteOff, document the behavior and make effective Hold visible in the mixer; if it does not, add a CanonLane regression before fixing scheduling. Then define the global arrangement-preset ownership schema and propose a small composer/era roster across classical, jazz, and video-game music.
context_notes: The native prototype is functional and visually approved enough to iterate directly. Main-page density is now compact, music colors are restored, note-key geometry stays fixed, and Setup has more breathing room. The next design task is not just naming presets: first lock what a global arrangement preset owns and ensure every field is backed by existing engine behavior. The Free Imitation complaint may be HoldMode semantics rather than a missing source NoteOff, but it remains unproven and must be reproduced rather than dismissed. Focused prototype work is committed in 2179294b and 1d4fa8f9.
